professionalSummary: Three years of experience as a Search Quality Analyst on a knowledge search product, consistently measuring search quality through the relevance judgement programme under the team’s measurement standard.
Expertise in analysing query logs for failure patterns, preparing weekly quality reports, and proposing ranking rule changes with documented expected effects and limitations.

experienceHighlights: Measured search quality via relevance judgement programme monthly, aligning with team standards (src_bacb9c2b5d2c).
Analyzed query logs weekly and produced quality reports for the product manager, filed in the search quality folder (src_a770d6135f2d).
Proposed nineteen ranking rule changes, each with expected impact, and secured approval or decline from the product manager (src_dbaa31fed503).
Coordinated judgement batches with six relevance judges, maintaining clear responsibility boundaries (src_c142dee9f8a3).
Authored limitation sections and hand‑over conditions for each ranking proposal, ensuring smooth transition to ranking engineers (src_55fb49d073a9).
projectsAndWorkSamples: Work sample: one weekly quality report, two ranking rule proposals with decision records, and one judgement batch design, all referenced in the search quality folder (src_01f190ce6e5e).
